name: Post-Alpha 0.60H - Hosted Clawd Persistence Foundation
playerPromise: Atlas now has the owner-protected memory needed for a map/chat app where users can see their local world, keep local business context, and later deploy Clawdbot as a paid neighborhood operator without leaving the voxel map surface.
engineeringPromise: Implement the first DB/Auth persistence foundation: Railway Postgres, SQL migration, OAuth/OIDC bearer verification, protected write routing, owned Hosted Clawd rows, business profile rows, Scout Drop saves, campaign draft saves, usage events, and idempotency. Stripe stays closed.

hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.localTestStorage: Postgres via DATABASE_URL; smoke skips cleanly when unset
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.authModel: OAuth/OIDC account linking for protected Hosted Clawd writes
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.authProviderShape: Auth0-compatible OIDC provider with issuer, audience, JWKS, and scopes
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.appsSdkAuthBoundary: MCP auth challenge for protected writes; iframe cookies and model text are not identity
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.firstPersistedCapability: owned Hosted Clawd plus business profile, Scout Drop summary, and campaign preview draft
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.idempotency: owner_user_id + operation + client_request_id returns original saved records
hostedClawdPersistenceFoundation.stripeTiming: 0.62H after 0.60H ownership and idempotency pass and 0.61H save UX proof

forbiddenScope: Stripe Checkout, Billing Portal, webhook endpoint, product, price, customer, or subscription mutation
public paid pricing or saved-state launch claims
automation, auto-posting, DMs, ads, scraping, or scheduled outreach
new public MCP tools before protected Hosted Clawd tools are separately approved
generic SaaS pricing page, dashboard shell, or long setup wizard

gates.label: HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_PERSISTENCE is reopened only for 0.60H owner-protected DB/Auth foundation
HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_MONEY remains closed until persistence and map-first save UX are proven
Hosted Clawd writes require verified OAuth/OIDC auth context; request bodies cannot claim owner identity
Persistence supports the Atlas map/chat product; it must not create a dashboard shell
HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_PUBLIC_CLAIM remains closed until pricing and saved-state claims are approved
